# 💰 Cribest7890's Currency Mod

**Add a complete economy system to your Minecraft world!**

Cribest's Currency Mod introduces a three-tier currency system inspired by precious metals, allowing you to build a realistic economy on your server or single player world.

---

## 🪙 Content

**Three types of coins:**
- ![bronze_coin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96ae04743c2dd47c6fd3c42a37a69c08cc31bf0b.png) **Bronze Coin** — the smallest denomination
- ![silver_coin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e954dab076da607166c6530eac8a0f1ed6868fc.png) **Silver Coin** — mid-tier value
- ![gold_coin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80e5f9dbb68f35d877af5d9d99db593b7889d93b.png) **Gold Coin** — the most valuable denomination


![coins_bag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10ec7180e7e196b9cb158589e0c3ee2f3be100b9.png)
**Coins Bag:**
A handy bag to collect and store your coins, complete with a dedicated GUI to manage your wealth with ease.

---

## ⚗️ Crafting & Conversion

Coins follow a conversion hierarchy:
- **Gold → Silver**
- **Silver → Bronze**

---

## ✨ Features

- Dedicated GUI for the coins bag
- Original textures for each coin
- Lightweight and optimized
- Compatible with **Fabric 1.21.8** or **NeoForge 1.21.8**

---

## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.8
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric/NeoForge
- **Fabric API** recommended

---

*Perfect for economy servers, medieval roleplay, or simply adding more depth to your gameplay!*
